moments.text: {name} from {residence} holds the door and waits like they already decided you are their person.
{name} saves you a seat and does not make a speech about it.
The lights go. {name} has a candle, two mugs, and nowhere else to be.
{name} asks if you are actually fine. You both know the answer is a long one.
Exam week. {name} slides notes under your door and leaves before you can perform gratitude.
{name} says, whatever the board says, you were here. That counts.
